					return

			function v_u_4.value46(p11)
				local v332 = v_u_4.value25 .. "/" .. p11 .. ".json"

				if not isfile(v332) then
					return
				end

				local function v333()
					return v_u_4.value6:JSONDecode(v_u_2({ readfile(v332) }))
				end

				local ok, result = pcall(v333)

				if ok then
					ok = type(result) == "table"
				end

				if not ok then
					return
				end

				local v336, v337, v338 = pairs(result)

				while true do
					local v339

					v338, v339 = v336(v337, v338)

					if not v338 then
						break
					end

					if getgenv()[v338] ~= nil then
						getgenv()[v338] = v339
					end
				end

				if result.Method then
					getgenv().AutoFarmConfig.Method = result.Method
				end

				if result.HeightOffset then
					getgenv().AutoFarmConfig.HeightOffset = result.HeightOffset
				end

				if result.MoveSpeed then
					getgenv().AutoFarmConfig.MoveSpeed = result.MoveSpeed
				end

				if result.MasteryFarmEnabled ~= nil then
					getgenv().MasteryFarmConfig.Enabled = result.MasteryFarmEnabled
				end

				if result.MasteryMode then
					getgenv().MasteryFarmConfig.Mode = result.MasteryMode
				end

				if getgenv().AutoKill then
					v_u_4.value39:Start()
				else
					v_u_4.value39:Stop()
				end

				if not getgenv().DeleteMap then
					return
				end

				v292()
			end
